newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Foster's says Molson stake is core asset.
newsitem.headline: Foster's says Molson stake is core asset.

text.p: Australia's Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said its 40 percent stake in Canada's Molson Breweries was a core asset and dismissed speculation it would sell out.
Foster's chief executive Ted Kunkel issued the statement after Foster's partner in the Canadian brewer, Molson Cos Ltd, was reported to have raised the prospect of Foster's exit.
Australian newspapers on Thursday published a report quoting Molson Cos' annual report as saying it wanted to buy out the Foster's stake.
Molson and Foster's each own 40 percent of Molson Breweries, with the rest belonging to Philip Morris Cos Inc through its subsidiary Miller Brewing Co.
Kunkel made no direct reference to the reports but said speculation about the Foster's stake was disruptive.
"This ongoing speculation is disruptive to Molson Breweries management, employees and brand partners," he said.
Molson Cos' reported desire to buy out Foster's comes as both partners negotiate to buy out Philip Morris' 20 percent stake in Molson Breweries.
Molson and Foster's have an agreement whereby the Philip Morris shareholding would be bought on a 50-50 basis, leaving Foster's and Molson with each 50 percent of Molson Breweries.
